description: Where the lab's extender on a wired backhaul (extender_5: bpiap-004, gen/wired-extender.sh) stands in each native layout, next to the two OpenSync pods: an edge or corner the native APs and pods leave free. build-goldens.py checks that it comes no closer than 3 dB to the best native AP of a band-steered client, on any band.
